questions.question: When people brought little children to Jesus, who did He say the kingdom of heaven belongs to?
When the Pharisees asked Jesus about divorce, which moment from the beginning did He point them back to?

answers.text: When the Creator made them male and female
When David became king of Israel

questions.question: When the Pharisees asked Jesus about divorce, why did He say Moses permitted it?
When the disciples rebuked people for bringing little children to Jesus, what did Jesus say?

answers.text: Let them come and do not hinder them
Let them wait until I finish teaching
Let them go home and come back later
